description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join an early-stage AI company building a new BIM authoring tool designed for AI agents. You will help shape its geometry and data foundations, generative design capabilities, and engineering direction, with scope to grow into a CTO role.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build the geometry and data core of a new BIM authoring tool.

 - Develop AI agents that can plan and edit real building models.

 - Create generative design workflows that account for building codes and client constraints.

 - Work across the stack, taking on unfamiliar technical areas as the product evolves.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience shipping commercial production software. One to two years may be suitable for candidates with a substantial track record of building projects independently.

 - Hands-on experience with 3D geometry or CAD, such as geometry kernels, B-rep or mesh modeling, CAD APIs, IFC, or Revit.

 - Regular, practical use of LLMs and AI agents in engineering work, ideally including generative or multimodal models for 3D or visual data.

 - A generalist mindset and ability to become productive quickly in unfamiliar areas, with startup or founder experience preferred.

 - Fluent English; German is not required.

 - Experience with Python and PyTorch, TypeScript and three.js, AEC or BIM workflows, or technical leadership and architecture ownership is valuable.

 - Based in Europe or willing to relocate to Europe, including the UK or Switzerland.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Stock options are offered.

 - Visa sponsorship is not available. Applicants must already be authorized to work in the EU, UK, or Switzerland.


LOCATION

Fully remote in the United Kingdom.
